rationale: With only 9 minutes to close and forced market liquidation at session end, the risk/reward is unfavorable regardless of direction. The stock is at the top of its intraday range (100th percentile) after a massive intraday recovery from $29.90 to $34.98, but the 5-minute candles show slowing momentum and mixed micro-price action near today's high of $34.87 — the last print at $34.98 is marginally above that high with no clear continuation signal. The broad market is under pressure (SPY -1.38%, VIXY +6.25%), and entering a long at the day's high with 9 minutes remaining and no news catalyst creates excessive gap-close risk; a short against a strong momentum move with forced cover at close is equally unattractive.
